invention.match: Match each inventor to their invention.
invention.reverse: Which of these inventors is known for {value}?

rows.label: Hedy Lamarr
rows.description: Austrian-American actress and co-inventor of an early technique for spread spectrum communications and frequency hopping (1914-2000)
rows.hook: starred in Hollywood films while co-developing a secret radio-guidance technique for torpedoes

rows.label: Thomas Edison
rows.hook: was nicknamed the Wizard of Menlo Park and patented over a thousand devices, including the phonograph

rows.label: Tim Berners-Lee
rows.hook: launched the first website and proposed the World Wide Web while working at CERN

rows.label: Alfred Nobel
rows.hook: left his fortune to fund yearly prizes for peace, physics, literature and more

rows.label: Johannes Gutenberg
rows.hook: produced a famous Bible in Mainz using movable metal type

rows.label: Ruth Handler
rows.hook: co-founded the toy company Mattel and created its best-known fashion doll

rows.label: Gerardus Mercator
rows.hook: drew a famous world map style that stretches lands near the poles and helped sailors navigate

rows.label: Jonas Salk
rows.hook: developed the first widely used shot that protected children from a crippling disease

rows.label: John Harvey Kellogg
rows.hook: ran a Michigan sanitarium and helped create a famous breakfast cereal with his brother

rows.label: Richard Stallman
rows.description: American software freedom activist, short story writer and computer programmer, founder of the GNU project
rows.hook: launched the free software movement and founded the GNU project

rows.label: James Naismith
rows.hook: created a winter game for restless students, scoring by tossing a ball into elevated peach baskets

rows.label: Alessandro Volta
rows.hook: stacked zinc and copper discs to produce the first steady flow of electric current

rows.label: John Pemberton
rows.hook: was an Atlanta pharmacist who created a famous fizzy soft drink

rows.label: Eli Whitney
rows.hook: built a machine that sped up cleaning a Southern cash crop and championed interchangeable musket parts

rows.label: Dean Kamen
rows.hook: created a two-wheeled self-balancing scooter and founded a youth robotics competition
